reviewLevel: assistant engineering review at native resolution; NOT human- or expert-verified; no consent or expert approval is claimed or implied
sourceRights: as recorded for the existing 115-photo review package / v4 TRAIN roles; publisher or dataset licence is not individual consent
scope: TRAIN positive photos of the review package only; DEV photos only evaluated; 941 UNKNOWN-cohort photos, failed product-evaluation photos and the sealed Skin care v5 test not used

targetSidePx.source: kept core positives, native SmartSkinCare resolution

boxRule: IGNORE when no clearly visible lesion (papule/pustule/whitehead bump or inflamed spot) lies inside the source box at this zoom: faint, empty, off-target, shadow/hair/edge or flat mark; KEEP otherwise. Source boxes are kept unchanged in the source record.
roiRule: ACCEPT only when the whole region inside the contour shows clearly clean visible skin; REJECT (stays UNKNOWN) on any spot, redness, raised texture, pigment, hair, shadow, finger, glare or tiny fragments
possibleUnlabeledLesionNote: engineering note only (region level, no box drawn): a distinct red/raised spot without a source box was seen inside these candidate regions; they stay UNKNOWN, never negative
